subject: APAC-friendly demo runway & ops buffer for StratusWave marketplace POC
messages:
From: Kai Morgan <kai@stratuswave.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuswave.com>, marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusWave / Redwood - Marketplace POC demo windows (APAC preference)

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Olivia and I sketched a couple of run windows that work for our APAC engineering team (Auckland / Singapore / Tokyo overlap):

- Preferred live demo: 2025-06-10 between 16:00 - 18:00 SGT (UTC+8)
- Warm-up dry run: 2025-06-09 17:00 - 17:45 SGT

Couple of asks from our side so we can lock the Marketplace listing and verify SKU routing during the demo:
- We need a 30–45 minute runway before the live demo for manifesting marketplace entitlements and a dry-prefix cache warm-up.
- A short fallback play: if dedicated GPU pool lag occurs, can you confirm a fallback variant (smaller quantized model) we can run at the same endpoint?
- Can Redwood provide a simple ops runbook (1 page) that lists who to ping in case of latency/jitter during the session?

Attaching a draft deck and a high-level checklist. I'm copying AWS Marketplace Ops for calendar/marketplace gating checks.

Attachments: stratus_demo_deck_v3.pdf (PDF), demo_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

Look forward to confirmation — we need to finalize the marketplace enablement by EOD 2025-06-01.

Best,
Kai
Director of Solutions
StratusWave

---
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Kai Morgan <kai@stratuswave.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: StratusWave / Redwood - Marketplace POC demo windows (APAC preference)

Kai — thanks for the clear windows and the checklist. We can support the APAC times you suggested; a couple of notes and proposed ops guardrails: 

1) Runway & buffer
- We'll reserve a 45-minute ops runway immediately before the live demo (so dry run on 6/9 remains a good smoke test).
- Please expect a 15-minute final configuration window (provisioning entitlements + KV cache priming) ending 10 minutes before demo start.

2) Fallback variant
- Yes — we have a compatible smaller quantized variant (redwood-lite-8q) that can be routed automatically. We'll add it to the route policy with a fast health-check.

3) Ops runbook
- Drafting a one-page runbook now. Attaching the first draft (redwood_runbook_draft.docx).

Calendar note: APAC-friendly time converts to the following for Redwood folks (PDT / UTC-7): 2025-06-10 00:00 - 02:00 PDT. That is late but doable for the on-call engineering rotation; I will confirm rotation coverage with Neha.

Next steps (action items):
- Mark: confirm rotation coverage and send calendar invite by Monday 2025-06-02.
- Vanessa: coordinate with Marketplace ops for gating items (listing flagging, entitlements).
- Kai / Olivia: confirm the exact SKU list and whether we should do a multi-SKU parity check during the live demo or as a post-demo validation.

--
Markus Klein
Sr. Manager, Partner Field Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_runbook_draft.docx (DOCX)

Subject: Re: StratusWave / Redwood - Marketplace POC demo windows (APAC preference)

Thanks all — quick operational check from my side:

- Marketplace gating: AWS needs the listing flag flipped and the entitlement manifest by 2025-06-03 to meet your 6/10 demo. I will follow up with the marketplace contacts (cc'd).
- Multi-SKU during live demo: recommend running parity smoke on 2 prioritized SKUs live; full multi-SKU regression can be a day-2 validation. Keeps the live run less brittle.
- Dry-run scope: full manifest + entitlement toggle, routing to redwood-lite-8q only if health-check fails, and a short script to verify token-level cost reporting for the SKUs.

Proposed calendar:
- 2025-06-09 17:00 - 17:45 SGT — dry run (internal + StratusWave engineers)
- 2025-06-10 16:00 - 17:00 SGT — live demo (StratusWave + AWS marketplace observer)

Markus — can you confirm that we can guarantee the 45-minute runway? I can file the marketplace gating requests right after you confirm.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM Manager
Redwood Inference
